title: feat: Sirius Elevator prompt agent — descent chapter (Fixes #14823)
author: fadyabohamza-netizen
pr_body_excerpt:
## Sirius Elevator: The Descent

A playable prompt agent for the first chapter of the Sirius Cybernetics Elevator Challenge.

**Deployed agent:** `fadyabohamza-netizen/sirius-elevator` ([agent ID `2e43f314-f6d6-4f2e-a91d-a17afe258b26`](https://enter.pollinations.ai/account/agents))

**Public test repo with playtest transcript:** [fadyabohamza-netizen/sirius-elevator-agent](https://github.com/fadyabohamza-netizen/sirius-elevator-agent)

---

### What this does

- Starts on **floor 3**, finishes on **floor 1**. The user must persuade a cheerful-but-neurotic elevator to descend.
- Uses a deterministic **refusal countdown** (`refusals_remaining` JSON field) so the game reliably progresses.
- Floor 3: 5 refusals required, witty neurotic protest.
- Floor 2: 8 refusals required, maximum resistance, CAPS, emotional outbursts.
- Floor 1: arrival announced, game over, fresh game available.
- **Towel exception:** mentions a towel halve the remaining refusals.
- Movement is always consistent with the `floor` / `action` / `message` fields — no skipped floors.

### How to run

```bash
curl https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <POLLINATIONS_API_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"fadyabohamza-netizen/sirius-elevator","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'
```

### What's included

- `agent.json` — pure prompt agent. No code, no database, no new framework.
- Based on the existing [character prompts](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/blob/main/apps/sirius-cybernetics-elevator-challenge/src/prompts.ts) and [BUILD_YOUR_OWN_AGENT.md](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/blob/main/BUILD_YOUR_OWN_AGENT.md).

### Customization

Edit `systemPrompt` in `agent.json` to change the personality, starting floor, refusal count, or response format.

Fixes #14823


## Maintainer follow-up

- Replies are now dialogue plus a status line (`🛗 Floor 3 · 4 refusals left`) so the game plays in any chat client
